To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) the RST structure can improve sentiment prediction, (2) machine learning can improve the prediction, and (3) the RST tree structure can be used as a feature for machine learning.

(1) the proposed RST-based aggregation of sentiment scores improves the prediction of stock returns, (2) the use of machine learning further improves the prediction, (3) machine learning is especially useful when the training set is small, and (4) the proposed feature engineering for machine-learning-based sentiment analysis is useful.
(1) sentiment aggregation with RST improves stock prediction, and (2) feature engineering with machine learning is superior to grid search.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the application of rhetoric discourse structures for sentiment analysis and the prediction of stock returns.
the question of whether and how semantic information from discourse structures can be utilized to improve sentiment analysis.
the question how to improve sentiment analysis by the inclusion of semantic relationships between (sub-)sentences.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our proposed method is able to improve sentiment analysis, as it considers document-level semantic information from rhetoric discourse structures.
the proposed method is a promising approach to improve sentiment analysis by incorporating document-level semantic relationships.
the use of RST is a promising approach to improve sentiment analysis, especially for financial texts, and that our proposed algorithms are an effective way of applying it.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are able to show the benefit of using RST for sentiment analysis.
sentiment analysis can be improved by incorporating document structure information.
we are able to improve the prediction of stock returns subsequent to a financial disclosure with the use of RST.
The main takeaway from our work is that
document-level semantic relationships from rhetoric structures can be used to improve sentiment analysis.
sentiment analysis can be significantly improved by considering semantic discourse information.
the RST tree is an effective means of aggregating sentiment scores from the document level.
